title: Alex is free for the next 7 days!
summary: Alex is the ultimate tool for iOS and Swift app development, empowering developers with AI for Xcode to streamline workflows, tackle complex coding challenges, and boost productivity. Discover what makes it an essential asset for modern app creation.
body_markdown:
To celebrate WWDC and showcase how far Alex has come, we’ve decided to make the app free for the next 7 days.


This means you can use any of our models like Claude Sonnet 4, OpenAI’s o3, and Gemini 2.5 Pro, without *any* limits! (It does not count against your message or code apply limits.)


**Build your app, automatically compile and fix errors, use the simulator, run reasoning models, add to agent memory, screenshot results, generate images, automatic web search, run terminal commands, and much more. All for free this week!**


---


## ✨ New: Generate up-to-date code with our @WWDC25 feature!


We’ve also added Apple’s latest announcements as a document you can @ import in your chats, letting you generate up-to-date code very easily!


(e.g. you can do @WWDC25, @Liquid Glass, or @Foundation Models!)


See the demo video[here](https://x.com/DanielEdrisian/status/1932640095645122890) .


Our new version (3.2.14) also works with Xcode 26 beta.


Excited to see what you build with Alex! Join our Discord for more announcements:[https://discord.gg/T5zxfReEnd](https://discord.gg/T5zxfReEnd)


- Daniel
